module.title: Dialog
module.description: The Dialog renderer and its options.

ui.name: dialog
ui.guidance: The platform supplies the top layer, the backdrop, the focus trap and Escape-to-close, and the close control is a `form method="dialog"` submit button - so the dialog dismisses with no JavaScript at all. The Alpine `uiDialog` component only calls showModal().
ui.keyboard: Escape closes it: this is a native <dialog>, so the platform supplies dismissal and the focus trap.
